correctness.rationale: At the flat configuration, the package gives an explicit rotational path with first-order planar matrix \(B\) and translation q. I independently reconstructed the six active vertex-side inequalities exactly in \(\mathbf Q(\sqrt3)\): \(Bq=(1/2,0)\), five active derivatives are \(-1/4+\sqrt3/8<0\), and the sixth is \(-1/4-5\sqrt3/8<0\). Every inactive inequality has strict slack at t=0, so continuity gives strict containment for all sufficiently small positive t. Scott's Theorem 4.3 then transports local Rupertness of the base polygon to local reverse Rupertness of its right prism.
